description: Return on a home renovation: value added vs cost, and how that value shrinks by the time you sell (straight-line over the project's economic life — an editable HomeCalc assumption, not a measured figure), plus any net rent the work earns.

currentHomeValue.description: Home value before the renovation in CAD

economicLifeYears.description: Years until the work adds nothing; omit for the type's default

monthlyNetRent.description: Net monthly rent the work earns (e.g. a legal suite) in CAD

projectType.description: Renovation type (sets the default value added and economic life)

valueAdded.description: Value the work adds at completion in CAD; omit to use the type's estimate

yearsUntilSale.description: Years between finishing the work and selling

name: renovation_roi
title: Renovation ROI Calculator (Canada)
